translations.EN: All right. Let us move on.
translations.TL: Sige. Magpatuloy na tayo.

translations.EN: No problem. Let us keep moving.
translations.TL: Walang anuman. Tuloy na tayo.

translations.EN: We are good. Let us get back to business.
translations.TL: Ayos na tayo. Balik na tayo sa ginagawa natin.

translations.EN: Done. No need to dwell on it.
translations.TL: Tapos na 'yon. Hindi na kailangang pag-usapan pa.

translations.EN: All right. Water under the bridge.
translations.TL: Sige. Lumipas na 'yon.

translations.EN: Let us put it behind us and focus on surviving.
translations.TL: Iwan na natin 'yan sa likod at magpokus sa kaligtasan.

translations.EN: Fine by me. Move forward.
translations.TL: Ayos lang sa 'kin. Abante na.

translations.EN: Okay. We move past it.
translations.TL: Sige. Kalimutan na 'yon.

translations.EN: Agreed. Let us not waste daylight on it.
translations.TL: Sang-ayon ako. Huwag nating sayangin ang oras diyan.

translations.EN: Understood. We are square.
translations.TL: Naiintindihan ko. Kuwits na tayo.

translations.EN: I accept the apology.
translations.TL: Tinatanggap ko ang tawad mo.

translations.EN: Apology accepted. We are fine.
translations.TL: Tanggap ko na. Ayos na tayo.

translations.EN: I appreciate you owning up to it.
translations.TL: Salamat at inamin mo ang pagkakamali mo.

translations.EN: Takes guts to say that out here. I accept.
translations.TL: Kailangan ng tapang para aminin 'yan dito. Tanggap ko.

translations.EN: Thank you. Apology accepted.
translations.TL: Salamat. Tanggap ko ang paumanhin.

translations.EN: We all make mistakes under pressure. Accepted.
translations.TL: Lahat naman nagkakamali kapag tensiyonado. Tanggap ko.

translations.EN: I hear you, and I accept.
translations.TL: Narinig kita, at tanggap ko.

translations.EN: Fair enough. Apology accepted.
translations.TL: Makatwiran. Tanggap ko ang paumanhin.

translations.EN: Good. I accept your apology.
translations.TL: Mabuti. Tinatanggap ko ang tawad mo.

translations.EN: I appreciate the honesty. We are good.
translations.TL: Salamat sa katapatan. Ayos na tayo.

translations.EN: Fine. We can put it behind us.
translations.TL: Sige. Iwan na natin sa nakaraan 'yon.

translations.EN: Let it go. We have bigger problems.
translations.TL: Hayaan mo na. Mas malaki ang mga problema natin.

translations.EN: It is done. No grudges.
translations.TL: Tapos na. Walang samaan ng loob.

translations.EN: Consider it forgotten.
translations.TL: Ituring mo nang limot na.

translations.EN: We are clear. Do not sweat it.
translations.TL: Malinaw na tayo. Huwag mo nang alalahanin.

translations.EN: Past is past. Watch your step next time.
translations.TL: Nakalipas na. Mag-ingat ka na lang sa susunod.

translations.EN: I am not holding onto it. Let us move.
translations.TL: Hindi ko na 'yan itatago sa loob ko. Tara na.

translations.EN: All right. We put it behind us.
translations.TL: Sige. Kalimutan na natin 'yan.

translations.EN: No hard feelings. Let us keep our heads on.
translations.TL: Walang samaan ng loob. Manatili tayong alisto.

translations.EN: Agreed. It is behind us now.
translations.TL: Sige. Tapos na 'yon ngayon.
